name: Bryce Sterling
source:
Bryce Sterling is the younger brother of Tanner Sterling and the son of Pierce and Margaret. Bryce - unlike his parents - is explicit and open about his contempt for Tanner's fiance, [url=/c134904/]Kate O'Malley[/url], whom he perceives to be a gold digger. He makes his first appearance in Chapter 1.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Bryce_Sterling]Wiki[/url]]
